summary: Phase 4 Faculty Board (مجلس الكلية) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (role gate 403 for teacher+student on all 9 endpoints, candidates, sessions validation/list, decision validation 400/404, course-scope de-dup, status override deprived/exempted via /api/reports/student/{id}/detailed, course-scope precedence over general, delete->revert to candidate, bulk session decisions, minutes+letter PDFs valid %PDF). A real candidate was seeded (2 completed lectures + absent records for student 1001 in test course RST-C1) and cleaned up afterwards. Frontend: found and FIXED 2 bugs in faculty-board.tsx (screen loaded no data after in-app navigation post-login; stale session decisions cache). After fixes, full UI flow passes: menu entry -> screen, course filter, refresh, checkbox/bulk bar, single + bulk decision modal (reason required alert, scope/decision chips, session picker), standalone decisions list, letter PDF download, delete with confirm, create session (validation alert + success), expand session shows its decisions, minutes PDF download. Teacher/student do not see the entry; direct URL shows 'غير مصرح' alert. Remaining HIGH issue: dean/department_head are not scoped to their faculty/department.

critical.issue: No organisational scoping for dean/department_head. Verified: Saeed (department_head of dept 698e501d97fef774e66e93a9, كلية البنات) sees candidate in course 'مقرر اختبار الاستعادة' of dept 698e500997fef774e66e93a8 (الشريعة والقانون) and can issue/delete decisions for any student university-wide. Candidates/decisions should be restricted to the user's faculty_ids/department_ids (admin unrestricted).

minor.issue: No endpoint to edit/delete a session (sessions created by mistake cannot be removed).
'warning' flag is computed as status in (warning, danger, candidate) so a 'deprived' student now has warning=false — deprived should probably still be flagged.
N+1: _student_info() queried per candidate and course_profiles per course (up to 300) — fine now (0.1s) but will slow with real data.

Bulk with scope=general for the same student across several selected courses creates/deletes repeatedly (last wins) and snapshot pct is taken from an arbitrary course; consider dedup by student for general scope.

ui_bugs.issue: Used useAuth() (AuthContext) whose user is null after a fresh login (login.tsx only calls authStore.setAuth). Result: after login and in-app navigation, useEffect returned early -> no candidates/sessions/courses fetched; empty state shown and course picker empty until manual refresh. Fixed by falling back to useAuthStore user. NOTE: same pattern exists in prep-leave-periods.tsx, backfill-sections.tsx, batch-print.tsx, letters.tsx, notifications.tsx, report-teacher-workload.tsx, send-department-results.tsx etc. — main agent should audit.

ui_bugs.component: faculty-board.tsx sessions tab (FIXED by testing agent)
ui_bugs.issue: expandSession cached decisions per session; after adding decisions to a session that had been expanded once, it kept showing 'لا قرارات في هذه الجلسة' while header said '1 قرار'. Fixed: always refetch on expand and reset cache/expanded on fetchSessions.

issues: Session date uses native browser <input type=date> rather than app date picker component
Unauthorized users visiting /faculty-board directly get an alert but the screen shell (tabs, create-session button) still renders — should redirect/return early
Candidate card: checkbox far left and decide button far right; acceptable in RTL but candidate row has wide empty middle on desktop

action_items: Add faculty/department scoping for dean & department_head in all faculty-board endpoints (candidates, decisions create/list/delete, PDFs)
Audit other screens using useAuth().user from AuthContext (null after fresh login) — same bug as faculty-board (e.g. prep-leave-periods.tsx)
Consider session delete/edit endpoint and early-return/redirect for unauthorized users on the screen
Treat 'deprived' as warning in student_report warning flag
critical_code_review_comments: _can_decide() is role-based (admin/dean/department_head) — Phase 3 permission-leak bug did NOT recur; teacher & student get 403 on all 9 endpoints
_save_decision uses delete_many+insert_one (non-atomic) — acceptable but a concurrent double-submit could create duplicates; consider a unique index on (student_id, scope, course_id) or upsert

Decision with scope=general but course_id supplied: course is looked up for snapshot but stored course_id=None — OK, but session_id is not validated in bulk items override (fine since forced to path id)

success_rate.frontend: 100% after 2 fixes applied by testing agent

Retest org scoping once main agent adds it (Saeed should NOT see RST-C1 candidate).
rca of the issue: Empty faculty-board after login: AuthProvider.user is only populated from AsyncStorage on app mount; login.tsx writes to zustand authStore and never calls AuthContext.login, so screens reading useAuth().user see null until full reload; the screen's useEffect `if (!user) return;` skipped all fetches. Repro: fresh login -> الإعدادات الأساسية -> مجلس الكلية -> empty list & course picker only 'كل المقررات' (refresh button works). Mitigation applied: `const user = ctxUser || useAuthStore(s=>s.user)`.
